title: Hands-on with DeepSeek Harness
summary: The same verified Python workflow as the flagship course — task contract, bounded change, objective verify.py evidence — taught hands-on in DeepSeek Harness: plugin-composed agents and an auditable append-only trajectory.
summaryZh: 与旗舰课程相同的已验证 Python 工作流——任务契约、有界改动、客观 verify.py 证据——在 DeepSeek Harness 里实战：插件组装的 Agent 与可审计的只增轨迹。
outcome: The same tested report tool as the flagship course (identical contract and nine-test suite), driven through a harness-composed agent — plus a compose-and-audit workflow that transfers to any capable coding agent.
outcomeZh: 与旗舰课程相同的报表工具（同一契约、同一九测套件），改由 Harness 组装的 Agent 驱动——外加一套可迁移到任何编码 Agent 的组装与审计工作流。
prerequisites: Python 3.11 or newer available on your PATH
A working DeepSeek Harness setup with a configured model plugin (your own API key or local endpoint)
Comfort running shell commands; no Python packages are installed for the exercise itself
prerequisitesZh: PATH 中有 Python 3.11 或更新版本
一套可用的 DeepSeek Harness 环境，配好模型插件（自备 API key 或本地端点）
能运行 shell 命令；练习本身无需安装任何 Python 包

lessons.title: Set up DeepSeek Harness, install the FlyPython Skill, fetch the course
lessons.titleZh: 装好 DeepSeek Harness、装上 FlyPython Skill、让 Agent 取回课程
lessons.objective: Start DeepSeek Harness, authorize the FlyPython Skill, fetch this course's files, and run the starter's objective check.
lessons.objectiveZh: 启动 DeepSeek Harness、授权 FlyPython Skill、取回本课文件，并运行 starter 的客观检查。

lessons.title: Write the task contract, let cordis.yml carry the setup
lessons.titleZh: 写任务契约，让 cordis.yml 承载配置
lessons.objective: Turn “make it better” into bounded, testable statements — then put the working rules into the agent's composition, not a forgotten prompt.
lessons.objectiveZh: 把「优化一下」变成有边界、可测试的陈述——再把工作规则写进 Agent 的组装配置，而不是会被遗忘的提示词。

lessons.title: The bounded change, audited from the trajectory
lessons.titleZh: 有界改动，用轨迹做审计
lessons.objective: Supervise the agent through small steps — one failing test group at a time — and prove it stayed in bounds by inspecting the trajectory.
lessons.objectiveZh: 监督 Agent 逐个小步骤推进——一次一组失败测试——并检查轨迹证明它没有越界。

lessons.title: Verify like a reviewer, not a spectator
lessons.titleZh: 像评审者一样验证，别当观众
lessons.objective: Complete the evidence loop — both verification directions, all three skins, an end-to-end trajectory review, and a written record of what is not proven.
lessons.objectiveZh: 完成证据闭环——双向验证、三个皮肤、端到端轨迹评审，以及一份写明未证明内容的记录。

lessons.title: Take the workflow to your own project
lessons.titleZh: 把工作流带回自己的项目
lessons.objective: Port the workflow — not the code — to one script you own, with tests, a verify command, and honest limits.
lessons.objectiveZh: 迁移工作流——而不是代码——到你拥有的一个脚本上，附测试、验证命令与诚实的局限说明。

scenarios.title: Excel / report automation
scenarios.blurb: Turn a messy weekly orders export into a per-region sales summary.
scenarios.blurbZh: 把混乱的每周订单导出变成按区域汇总的销售摘要。

scenarios.title: Data monitor script
scenarios.blurb: Aggregate service latency numbers and isolate malformed readings.
scenarios.blurbZh: 汇总服务延迟数据，并隔离格式错误的读数。

scenarios.title: Small API tool
scenarios.blurb: Summarize ticket data pulled from an internal API (JSON input).
scenarios.blurbZh: 汇总从内部 API 拉取的工单数据（JSON 输入）。

verification.method: Identical contract and nine-test suite to the flagship course: the starter must reproduce seven named failures; the reviewed solution passes 9/9; your bounded change passes the same suite in lesson 3.
verification.methodZh: 与旗舰课程相同的契约与九测套件：starter 必须复现七个具名失败；已审核实现 9/9 通过；第 3 课中你的最小变更通过同一套件。

badge.nameEn: Reproduce with DeepSeek Harness in the loop

levelZh: 对新手友好；需要读代码的耐心
